rationale: The agent identified the user via name and ZIP, but then performed multiple order-changing actions (two cancellations and two returns) without explicit user confirmation, violating the policy and the user’s stated preference to do one thing at a time. The agent did not clearly provide the tablet’s tracking number, nor did it properly handle the request to refund or reorder the lost tablet or escalate to a human when appropriate. The cancellation set appears incomplete (user asked to cancel charger, boot, and kettle—three items—yet only two cancellations were executed), and one of the returns may not have been requested beyond the sneaker. Overall, actions were taken without confirmation, requested items were not fully or clearly addressed, and essential information (tracking number) was not provided.
